question: Para saan ang Certificate of Completion of Subdivision ug kinsa nga komite ang mo-endorse niini ngadto sa DHSUD?
answer: Ang Certificate of Completion of Subdivision ay maaayo sa City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) na ang mag-endorse sa application sa DHSUD. [S1]

ground_truth: The Certificate of Completion of Subdivision (COC) is a resolution from the City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) favorably endorsing to DHSUD/HLURB that the project has been fully completed according to approved engineering plans.
